description: This file defines the 'LogNode' interface, which specifies a method for outputting log data within a logging system. It includes a method 'println' for printing logs with various parameters such as priority, tag, message, and optional Throwable.

classes.name: LogNode
classes.description: Interface for a logging node that outputs log data, possibly to different targets or filters.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Outputs a log message with specified priority, tag, message, and optional exception.
